description: This Java class implements the WriteSurveyService interface in the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods for registering surveys and fulfilling surveys by interacting with the database and managing permissions for survey-related data tables.

classes.name: WriteSurveyServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the WriteSurveyService interface, handling survey registration and fulfillment logic.

methods.name: registerSurvey
methods.description: Registers a new survey using the provided JSON command, retrieves the related data table name, and sets permissions.

methods.name: fullFillSurvey
methods.description: Fulfills a survey by creating an entry in the specified data table for a given application ID.

methods.name: getPermissionSql
methods.description: Generates the SQL statement to insert permission entries for the survey data table.
